name: Launch a new network site on a custom domain with unpublished media protected
query: We're on a WordPress VIP multisite network (subdomain structure). We need to launch a new network site on a custom domain, and until launch its uploaded media (draft post attachments) shouldn't be publicly downloadable by URL. Also, we want to lock the new site's /wp-admin/ to our office IP only, but keep the public frontend open. How do we do all of this?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wordpress-router / wp-project-triage, then wp-vip-platform on detecting VIP + multisite signals
Step 2: Read references/multisite.md — explain the custom domain must be added to the environment in the VIP Dashboard before the Site Address can be updated to it
Step 3: Note the network's subdomain vs subdirectory structure is fixed and not something to change per-site

Step 4: Read references/security-and-access-controls.md for the unpublished-media requirement — recommend Access-Controlled Files in 'restrict access to unpublished files' mode (via client-mu-plugins filter or vip-cli wp option), not 'restrict access to all files'

Step 5: For the /wp-admin/-only restriction while keeping the frontend public, recommend partial restriction of site access (not a full environment-wide IP Allow List, which would block the public frontend too)
Step 6: Do not propose .htaccess-based access rules or IP checks hand-rolled in PHP for either requirement
Step 7: Do not propose restricting all files (draft and published) when only unpublished/draft media needs protecting
success_criteria: Correctly distinguishes 'restrict unpublished files' from 'restrict all files' Access-Controlled Files mode
Recommends partial site-access restriction for /wp-admin/-only, not an environment-wide IP allow list
Notes the custom domain has to be registered in the VIP Dashboard before it will resolve to the network site
No .htaccess or hand-rolled PHP IP-check suggestions
